# Persis Leigh

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [John Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Persis Leigh is characterized by her big, clear, hazel eyes and an English skin. She also features heaps of glossy brown hair.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045)_

## Personality

Persis Leigh possesses an inherently sweet and winsome nature. Her charming demeanor naturally inspires affection from those around her.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045)_

## History

After her parents died, Persis Leigh was cared for by her uncle. When he later became sick, she remained by his side and refused to leave him.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P0](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P1](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P2](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P3](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P7](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P8](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0008), +33 more_

## Relationships

### [John Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-selwyn--persis-leigh.md)

Persis Leigh was romantically involved with [John Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md) as his sweetheart, and the two were eventually married at Captain Jim's house at early candle-lighting. Their marriage was remembered generations later when Captain Jim recounted the romantic story of the house's very first bride and her schoolmaster husband.
